title: 义务教育教科书·英语（PEP）四年级上册

sentences.en: My dad is tired after work.
I always play football with him.
There is a park near my home.
I read books in the library.
I buy books in the shop.
My father is a police officer.
The driver is on the bus.
What is the weather like tomorrow?
I wear a warm coat in winter.
Let's get together in the snow.
